title: Collapse
summary: A compact bordered panel group that reveals related content with clear headers, an expand icon, and independent open states.
overview: Collapse panels hide supporting content behind concise headers. This example uses a joined, bordered group with a subtle header surface and allows multiple panels to stay open, following Ant Design’s default Collapse behavior.

component.useWhen: Use collapse panels to group optional or supporting content so readers can open only the sections they need.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid collapsing essential instructions, or use an accordion variant when only one panel should remain open at a time.

examples.title: Bordered independent panels
examples.description: Open and close panels independently. The joined borders, soft header surface, leading chevron, and white content area follow Ant Design’s Collapse presentation.

variants.title: Single-open accordion
variants.summary: Keep at most one panel expanded. Opening another panel closes the previous one automatically.
variants.useWhen: Use accordion behavior when readers should focus on one section at a time and the surrounding panels are closely related.
variants.avoidWhen: Keep independent panels when readers may need to compare or refer to several sections at once.
customization: Opening a closed panel closes the currently open panel; activating the open panel collapses it.
Keep the same trigger and panel relationships as independent Collapse panels.
Consider whether the content remains discoverable when every panel is closed.

anatomy.name: Collapse group
anatomy.description: A bordered container that keeps related panels visually connected.

anatomy.name: Panel header
anatomy.description: A full-width button with a leading expand icon, title, and optional extra content.

anatomy.name: Panel content
anatomy.description: A padded region connected to its trigger and removed from focus order while collapsed.

accessibility: Use a real button for each panel trigger and connect it to the content with aria-controls.
Keep aria-expanded synchronized with the visible panel state.
Give each panel region an accessible name and make collapsed content inert.
Use accordion behavior only when the interaction should enforce one open panel at a time.
component.responsive: Panel headers wrap naturally at narrow widths while retaining a large full-row hit area; body padding reduces on small screens.
limitations: The example supports independently open panels; accordion single-open behavior is not included in this variant.

provenance.label: Ant Design Collapse behavior and visual study
provenance.note: Original native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript follow Ant Design’s bordered joined panels, subtle headers, leading chevron, and independent default expansion behavior.

source.javascript: export function createNavbar(root){const toggle=root.querySelector('[data-navbar-toggle]'),links=root.querySelector('[data-navbar-links]');if(!toggle||!links)throw new Error('Navbar markup is incomplete.');const close=()=>{toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');toggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Open navigation');links.dataset.open='false';};const onToggle=()=>{const open=toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));toggle.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close navigation':'Open navigation');links.dataset.open=String(open);};const onKey=event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'&&toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true'){close();toggle.focus();}};const onLink=event=>{if(event.target.closest('a'))close();};toggle.addEventListener('click',onToggle);root.addEventListener('keydown',onKey);links.addEventListener('click',onLink);return{destroy(){toggle.removeEventListener('click',onToggle);root.removeEventListener('keydown',onKey);links.removeEventListener('click',onLink);}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-navbar]').forEach(createNavbar);

source.javascript: export function createBottomSheet(root){const trigger=root.querySelector("[data-trigger]"),sheet=root.querySelector("[data-sheet]"),close=root.querySelector("[data-close]"),handle=root.querySelector("[data-handle]");if(!trigger||!sheet||!handle)return{destroy(){}};let open=true,startY=0,startOffset=0,dragging=false;const collapsedOffset=()=>Math.max(0,sheet.offsetHeight-34);const setOpen=(value)=>{open=value;sheet.classList.toggle("is-hidden",!open);sheet.style.transform="";trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(open));handle.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(open));handle.setAttribute("aria-label",open?"Drag to collapse bottom sheet":"Drag to expand bottom sheet");};const pointerDown=(event)=>{if(event.button!==undefined&&event.button!==0)return;dragging=true;startY=event.clientY;startOffset=open?0:collapsedOffset();sheet.classList.add("is-dragging");handle.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);};const pointerMove=(event)=>{if(!dragging)return;const offset=Math.max(0,Math.min(collapsedOffset(),startOffset+event.clientY-startY));sheet.style.transform=`translateY(${offset}px)`;};const pointerUp=(event)=>{if(!dragging)return;dragging=false;sheet.classList.remove("is-dragging");try{if(handle.hasPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId))handle.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);}catch{}const matrix=new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(sheet).transform);const offset=matrix.m42;setOpen(offset<collapsedOffset()/2);};const keydown=(event)=>{if(event.key==="ArrowDown"){event.preventDefault();setOpen(false);}else if(event.key==="ArrowUp"){event.preventDefault();setOpen(true);}};const toggle=()=>setOpen(!open);const hide=()=>setOpen(false);handle.addEventListener("pointerdown",pointerDown);handle.addEventListener("pointermove",pointerMove);handle.addEventListener("pointerup",pointerUp);handle.addEventListener("pointercancel",pointerUp);handle.addEventListener("keydown",keydown);trigger.addEventListener("click",toggle);close?.addEventListener("click",hide);return{destroy(){handle.removeEventListener("pointerdown",pointerDown);handle.removeEventListener("pointermove",pointerMove);handle.removeEventListener("pointerup",pointerUp);handle.removeEventListener("pointercancel",pointerUp);handle.removeEventListener("keydown",keydown);trigger.removeEventListener("click",toggle);close?.removeEventListener("click",hide);}}}document.querySelectorAll("[data-component=\"bottom-sheet\"]").forEach(createBottomSheet);
